segments.he: הַסָּרִיס שֶׁחָלַץ לִיבִמְתּוֹ לֹא פְּסָלָהּ כּוּ׳. טַעְמָא דִּבְעָלָהּ הוּא, הָא אַחֵר — לָא,
segments.en: § It is further taught in the mishna that if «a eunuch performed ḥalitza with his yevama, he has not» thereby «disqualified her» from marrying into the priesthood, but if he had intercourse with her, he has disqualified her. The Gemara infers from this wording that «the reason» for her disqualification «is that he,» the yavam, «had intercourse with her,» as she had intercourse with her yavam outside the framework of permitted levirate marriage. «But» if «a different» individual had relations with her she would «not» be disqualified.
